environment: Local app with real Gmail SMTP and read-only IMAP of the two uniquely addressed test messages

checks.name: Gmail SMTP TLS connection and authentication
Read-only Gmail inbox access for test message verification
Real SMTP signup creates an unverified pending account without session or local inbox link
Verification email received in Gmail INBOX with usable six-digit code
Inbox verification code verifies the account
Verified account still requires manager approval
Password-reset email received in Gmail INBOX with usable six-digit code
Verification code cannot reset the password
Inbox reset code changes the password
Password reset revokes the previous session
New password signs in and accesses the authenticated profile
Temporary test account and its codes removed; existing accounts and inventory preserved

externalEmail: Verified: Gmail SMTP accepted both messages; both reached Gmail INBOX; their codes completed verification and password reset.
scope: Two messages addressed to a unique plus-alias of the configured Gmail sender. Read-only IMAP fetched only those test messages. A temporary staff account was activated as a fixture to test login and reset, then deleted with its codes. Existing user accounts and inventory were preserved. This checks the configured Gmail inbox, not every recipient provider.

tests.name: Live Gmail verification email, one-time code, and approval gate
Live Gmail reset email, new password, session revocation, and code replay
